title: System Admin tour
whatsNewText: We have added something new here since your last visit.

steps.title: Welcome to System Admin
steps.text: This is where TNA Africa runs the SaaS: tenants, clocking devices, costing, users and legal documents. This quick tour shows you around. You can start it again any time from the ? button.

steps.title: The menu
steps.text: Screens are grouped: Operations for daily work and Settings & reports for set-up and billing. System Admin holds costing, users, audit logs, legal documents and the API.

steps.title: Live overview
steps.text: Active tenants and online / offline devices. Click a card to open that screen. The Offline card pulses red when a device is offline.

steps.title: Your profile
steps.text: Your name and role. Click it for Light / Dark mode, What's new and Log out.

steps.title: Light / Dark mode and Log out
steps.text: Switch the theme here. Your choice is remembered on this device. Log out is recorded in the Audit Logs.

steps.title: Help is always here
steps.text: Open ? to replay this tour, tour the screen you are on, see What's new, or follow a step-by-step how-to guide.

steps.title: New tenant
steps.text: Start a new client here. The onboarding wizard asks the questions step by step and works out the costs.

steps.title: New: step-by-step onboarding
steps.text: Start onboarding walks you through the client's employees, modules, extras and demo mode, shows the once-off and monthly cost, and saves as you go.

steps.title: Your tenants
steps.text: Grouped by reseller. Edit changes modules and pricing, Licenses shows facial licences, Info shows employees, credits and history.

steps.title: Pending quotes
steps.text: Every quote with its status, the step it reached and what is still missing. Continue picks up where you left off.

steps.title: In progress or deployed
steps.text: Switch between quotes still being prepared and the ones already deployed.

steps.title: Live employee check
steps.text: Active modules and live employee numbers per tenant, against what was loaded. Over Cap means the tenant uses more employees than it pays for.

steps.title: Rebuild history
steps.text: Rebuilds the monthly active-employee history used on each tenant's Info screen.

steps.title: Find a device
steps.text: Search by serial number or name.

steps.title: Link devices to tenants
steps.text: Pick the tenant and press Update Link. Punches received while a device was unlinked are held and move in when you link it.

steps.title: Manage a device
steps.text: Reboot, sync time, recover logs, face settings and the Command Queue, which shows what was sent to the device and its reply.

steps.title: Screen pictures
steps.text: Send a wallpaper or a screensaver advert to a device.

steps.title: Face recognition settings
steps.text: Fetch Live reads the device's current settings; change them and queue them to the device.

steps.title: Your logo
steps.text: Upload the company logo shown at the top of the Global Admin and System Admin menu. The menu is dark in both themes, so a white or light logo on a transparent background looks best. Uploads and removals are recorded in the Audit Logs.

steps.title: System email
steps.text: The mail server the system sends from. Use Send Test Email below to check it works.

steps.title: Single Sign-On
steps.text: Google and Microsoft app IDs for the Login page. Leave one blank and its button is switched off.

steps.title: Device ports
steps.text: Extra ports the clocking devices can connect on, for sites with strict firewalls. Saving restarts the device service.

steps.title: Export to Excel
steps.text: Activation Fees exports the once-off fees, Monthly Charges the monthly totals, for every tenant.

steps.title: Charges per tenant
steps.text: Once-off and monthly totals per tenant. Use the icons on a row to export or print that tenant only.

steps.title: This changes a live tenant
steps.text: New tenants now use Start onboarding. This form is only for changing a tenant that is already live.

steps.title: Costs
steps.text: Costs come from Global Module Costing. Only System Admin can give a special price.

steps.title: Billing options for finance
steps.text: Choose which ways of billing per-employee modules BPs may offer in onboarding (fixed, peak, actual, average, seasonal), and the default.

steps.title: Module costing
steps.text: The standard cost of every module. New quotes use these; a special price for one tenant is set in its pricing table.

steps.title: Alert emails
steps.text: These addresses get the full cost breakdown whenever a tenant is added or changed.

steps.title: Extra costs
steps.text: Travel, consulting and similar items you can add to any tenant's pricing.

steps.title: Resellers
steps.text: Business partners that tenants can be assigned to. MY COMPANY is the default.

steps.title: Master billing report
steps.text: Emails the full tenant billing summary to the alert emails above.

steps.title: System users
steps.text: Create Global Admin users. System Settings opens System Admin at login; Deploy Tenants shows the Deploy button on quotes.

steps.title: Change a user's rights
steps.text: Tick or untick a right; it takes effect at their next login. Every change is recorded in the Audit Logs.

steps.title: Link a BP user to a reseller
steps.text: Pick a reseller for a BP user and they only see that reseller's tenants and quotes. All resellers = sees everything. System Admin users always see everything.

steps.title: Who did what
steps.text: Every Global Admin change: the user, the screen, what was done, when and from which IP. Logo uploads and log-outs are recorded too.

steps.title: Write the new version
steps.text: Edit the wording, Preview it, then Publish New Version. You sign it off with your name and position.

steps.title: Version history
steps.text: Every published version, who published it and when.

steps.title: Privacy policy
steps.text: Write, preview and publish the privacy policy, the same way as the Terms & Conditions.

steps.title: Version history
steps.text: Every published version, who published it and when.

steps.title: Demo / Setup mode
steps.text: Lets a company set up, train and test on a copy of its own data. Switch it on per company and set a test mailbox; nothing done in the copy touches the live system.

steps.title: Master API key
steps.text: Read-only access to the tenant list for other systems, such as the Support desk. A new key stops the old one working straight away.

steps.title: Demo Data Sync
steps.text: Fills ONE demo tenant with scrubbed employees (clocks come from the normal CVS sweeper). Below the switch: Demo settings (schedule, departments, name style, keep my edits), Site names shown instead of the real CVS devices, and the Run history. Read the warning first and never pick a live customer tenant.

steps.title: Eight short steps
steps.text: Company, employees, modules, extras, demo mode, admin login, documents and review. Click any step to jump to it.

steps.title: Every Next saves
steps.text: Save & next saves this step and moves on. Only the company name is needed to start, so you can stop half way and finish later.

steps.title: Save and come back later
steps.text: Saves and closes. The quote waits under Onboarding & quotes with the step you reached and what is still missing.

steps.title: Where the quote is
steps.text: Draft → Quote sent → Accepted → Ready to deploy → Deployed. You move it on from the Review step.

steps.title: Who did what
steps.text: Every save, status change and deploy is recorded with the user and the time.

steps.title: Move the quote on
steps.text: Mark it sent, then accepted. System Admin checks it, marks it Ready to deploy and deploys it.

guides.title: Upload your logo
guides.blurb: Show your logo at the top of the menu

steps.title: Open Global Settings
steps.text: Click Global Settings in the menu.

steps.title: Choose the image
steps.text: PNG, JPG or WEBP up to 1 MB. The preview shows it on the menu background before you save.

steps.title: Upload it
steps.text: Press Upload logo. Every Global Admin user sees it the next time their page loads. Use default removes it again.
